title: refactor: rollout autorollback workflow engine and add stability guards
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: The current autorollback workflow has grown organically and mixes probing, quarantine, and rollback decision logic across multiple services. This makes it hard to reason about failure modes and to add new stability guards for staged canary/shadow traffic. This PR refactors the autorollback engine into a single orchestrator component, extracts metric quorum and quarantine logic into reusable modules, and adds explicit safety guards (rate-of-change, metric stability window, quorum thresholding). Changes are backwards-compatible at the API surface: existing rollout configs continue to work. The refactor also consolidates observability and introduces new telemetry emitted during preflight, probing, and rollback decisions so SREs can debug regressions more easily. Checklist: - [x] extract autorollback decision engine into orchestrator - [x] implement metric quorum helper and quarantine stage - [x] add stability guard checks (rate-of-change, min-samples, preflight delay) - [x] update e2e and unit tests - [x] update rollout docs and telemetry mapping - [x] integrate canary + shadow probing paths into single workflow Migration notes: No config migration is required for customers using the managed rollout API. Internal rollout controller uses the new orchestrator by default behind a feature flag rollout.orchestrator.v2=false for staged ramp-up in the next release. Rollout logic summary: - Stage: preflight (smoke + sample checks) - Stage: probing (shadow traffic + targeted probing queries) - Stage: quarantine (isolate failing cohorts) - Decision: use multi-metric quorum and rate-of-change to decide rollback or continue Implementation details: - New package rollout/orchestrator implements a deterministic state machine that drives canary/AB/shadow paths. - Metric evaluation was moved to rollout/metrics with a pluggable interface for composite metrics. - Quarantine is implemented as a separate stage that can be triggered automatically or manually. - Observability: new telemetry events rollout.preflight_passed, rollout.probing_summary, rollout.quarantine_triggered, rollout.rollback_decision with structured tags for model, route, and metric fingerprints. Testing: added unit tests for orchestrator state transitions, end-to-end integration tests that simulate canary + shadow scenarios, and rollback-triggered CI job that verifies metric-driven rollback triggers. Risks and mitigations: - Risk: edge cases in state transitions. Mitigation: included deterministic state fuzz tests and added additional invariants in the orchestrator. - Risk: transient noise causing false positives. Mitigation: introduced stability_window and quorum thresholds; default values are conservative. Related: ENG-2142, ENG-2178, SUP-1420. See linked Linear tasks for rollout validation matrices.

release_notes: Refactor rollout autorollback engine into orchestrator; add metric quorum and quarantine stage; introduce stability guards and additional telemetry. Backwards compatible. No customer action required.
notes_for_oncall: If customers observe unexpected rollbacks after deploy, check rollout.preflight_passed and rollout.probing_summary telemetry for noisy metrics; use the quarantine API to isolate cohorts. Feature flag rollout.orchestrator.v2 can be toggled on the controller if a quick rollback to previous behavior is needed.
